slides.h1: Before you market, build a launch kit.
slides.lead: Five things to have ready so day one isn't chaos.
You'll paste it everywhere: bio, flyer, ads, DMs.
No detours. One tap from "interesting" to "downloading".
Big, high contrast, and tested on a real phone before you print.
One area, one kind of user. Win small before you go wide.
Separate links or QR codes per channel, so you see what actually brings installs.

points: Problem: in big towers, nobody knows their neighbors
Flyers with QR codes via a distribution vendor
